summary: Cryo-Cell International filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing logistics for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. The board fixed October 27, 2026 as the meeting date and September 21, 2026 as the record date for notice and voting. The bylaws' advance-notice deadlines for stockholder business and director nominations both passed on July 27, 2026, so no new nominations are expected. No deal terms, advisors, or recommendations appear. This is an ordinary meeting-notice filing, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies, though the October meeting could see routine governance items.
